channel.title: Football's Greatest Bears News
channel.description: Original FGB-written Chicago Bears news briefs with source attribution for Football's Greatest Bears live programming.

item.title: Kyle Monangai's hyperextended knee will sideline him multiple weeks, creating fresh uncertainty for the Bears' Week 1 backfield
item.description: FGB brief: Sports Illustrated reports Monangai suffered a hyperextended knee and is expected to miss multiple weeks, though the Bears view the diagnosis as positive compared with what they initially feared.

item.title: Bears activate Ozzy Trapilo while clearing three injured players as the offensive tackle competition gains another option
item.description: FGB brief: Chicago's official transaction log shows Trapilo was activated Aug. 16, while K.C. Eziomume, Kyron Hudson and Gervarrius Owens were waived with injury settlements.

item.title: Ben Johnson's reserve offense rolls as Tyson Bagent and Case Keenum combine for 320 yards and three touchdowns
item.description: FGB analysis: NFL.com says Chicago's offense stayed productive without its starters, with Bagent and Keenum combining for 320 passing yards and three touchdowns while several reserve skill players strengthened roster cases.

item.title: Six Bears reserves strengthen roster cases as Kaden Davis, Jamree Kromah and Beanie Bishop headline Cleveland win
item.description: FGB brief: ChicagoBears.com highlighted Davis' 88 receiving yards, Kromah's two sacks and Bishop's two interceptions among six reserve performances that stood out in the 34-10 preseason victory.

item.title: Antwaan Randle El sparks 24-point second half after Ben Johnson hands him Bears play-calling duties
item.description: FGB analysis: CBS Sports reports Chicago scored 24 second-half points after receivers coach Antwaan Randle El took over play calling, earning strong praise from Johnson for his future coaching potential.

item.title: Ben Johnson says the Bears are chasing historic scoring, shutouts and blowouts rather than treating a Super Bowl as enough
item.description: FGB analysis: Johnson has set an intentionally extreme standard for 2026, including surpassing Denver's 2013 scoring record and building the kind of dominance that extends beyond simply winning a championship.

item.title: Bears head to Cincinnati next week for a joint practice before their second preseason game against the Bengals
item.description: FGB brief: Yahoo Sports' training-camp schedule lists Chicago's next major checkpoint as an Aug. 20 joint practice in Cincinnati, followed by the Aug. 22 preseason matchup with the Bengals.
